docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
James's Gifford Lectures: conversion, saintliness and mysticism studied as experiences, with the cases of the people who lived them.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

William James (1842–1910), The Varieties of Religious Experience: A Study in Human Nature, 1902. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
